description: Update tags on a Zendesk ticket via PUT request to /api/v2/tickets/{ticket_id}/tags. Use when you need to add, replace, or manage tags on an existing ticket. This operation replaces all existing tags with the provided list.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for updating ticket tags in Zendesk.

tags.description: An array of tag names to set on the ticket. Using this endpoint replaces all existing tags on the ticket with the provided tags.
tags.title: Tags

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket to update tags for.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id

inputSchema.title: UpdateTicketsTagsRequest

name: update_tickets_tags

UpdateTicketsTagsResponse.description: Response containing the updated ticket tags.

tags.description: An array of tag names now associated with the ticket.
tags.title: Tags

UpdateTicketsTagsResponse.title: UpdateTicketsTagsResponse
